title: What water tells about a town
text:
I decided to do this tour together with a friend because it seemed like a very special proposal that could teach us things and take us along paths that we would not have been able to discover without someone to guide us. We were not disappointed.

Our guide, José, was incredibly knowledgeable about the history of Granada, the Alhambra, the archaeological projects around it, and the ecological and reforestation initiatives taking place around the Alhambra forests. All this without taking center stage from the history of water management systems and the value that has been given to it throughout
